text:
marco (product): sharing a quick mock + notes — want a rapid gut-check on the in-console docs surface before we ship the panel updates. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/console/docs-surface-v3.png

riley (design): looked — thanks. main thing: the header reads 'Help' in some screens and 'Docs' in others. That confuses users and our search analytics. recommend we pick one label and keep the icon consistent. also the quicklinks order feels random.

sam (devex): agree on label. +1 to 'Docs' as it maps to external hub. Also: deep links from the API page currently open in a modal but lose keyboard focus when closed. That's a regression.

taylor (eng-platform): deploy-bot shows the modal is mounted via portal; I can add focus return, but need a clear target element to focus back to. which CTA should get the return-focus?

marco (product): the CTA on the API page is 'View docs' (primary). return focus to that button makes sense.

riley (design): propose we: 1) standardize label to 'Docs' across console 2) move 'Quicklinks' into primary nav order: Overview, Docs, Examples, Billing 3) add a visible breadcrumb in the Docs panel so folks know they're still in-console (tiny copy: 'Console Docs — /api/generate').

jamie (a11y): a few accessibility nits from testing: - Panel needs aria-modal and role=document? prefer role=dialog with aria-labelledby pointing at the panel title. - All links in docs panel must include descriptive text (avoid 'click here'). - Ensure <kbd> shortcuts are exposed via a visually hidden element for screen readers.

sam (devex): good catches. also analytics: we have two event names firing for the same user action: docs.panel.open and help.drawer.open. that'll mess up funnels. we should consolidate to docs.panel.open and deprecate help.drawer.*

taylor (eng-platform): I can handle focus return + rename events in the next sprint. will add a deprecated alias for a couple weeks to keep dashboards stable.

marco (product): quick UX question: do we keep the 'Open in new tab' icon on every external doc link or only on deep-links that leave the console?

riley (design): show it on any link that opens a new tab. consistent affordance is less surprising. small icon after link text is fine.

jamie (a11y): ensure the icon has aria-hidden=true and the link text includes "(opens in new tab)" for screen readers OR use aria-label on link to expose that. prefer the latter to avoid verbose visible copy.

sam (devex): cross-linking: we should add an anchor that takes people to the exact in-product panel state, e.g., /console?docs=/api/streaming#troubleshooting. that helps support sharebacks and recordings. needs router support.

taylor (eng-platform): router already supports query strings; I'll add a small mapping layer so legacy /help?topic= maps to the new docs query param.

riley (design): copy proposal for panel header (short):
```
Docs — Console reference
Search docs, examples, and API runbooks for running models in production.
```
Keep header concise and the secondary line small.

marco (product): love it. final decision checklist?
1) Rename surface to 'Docs' globally — owner: product (marco)
2) Update quicklinks order and add breadcrumb — owner: design (riley)
3) Focus return on panel close — owner: eng-platform (taylor)
4) Consolidate analytics event names — owner: devex (sam)
5) A11y fixes (role, readable new-tab semantics, keyboard hints) — owner: a11y (jamie)
6) Router deep-link aliasing for old help links — owner: eng-platform (taylor)

riley (design): I'll drop a tiny PR with updated mock and copy snippets by EOD for the docs team to review. :spiral_note_pad:

taylor (eng-platform): will slot the focus/alias work into next sprint and open an RFC for the event rename so infra dashboards aren't broken.

sam (devex): i'll update analytics and forward-compat deprecations in the telemetry repo, then ping dashboards owners.

deploy-bot: deployed prototype to staging https://staging.redwood.dev/console?docs=/api/streaming (build 2026-11-02T14:12Z) :rocket:

marco (product): great, let's reconvene after staging review. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
